headline: Safe storage covers every owner

items.title: G.L. c.140, s.131L
items.detail: A firearm must be in a locked container or have a tamper-resistant lock unless it is under the owner's control.

items.title: No children required
items.detail: The requirement applies to owners and authorized users, with or without minors in the home.

items.title: Penalty
items.detail: Standard firearms: a fine of $1,000 to $7,500 or up to 1.5 years in jail.

sources: Sources: malegislature.gov (G.L. c.140, s.131L; accessed Sep 25, 2026)
